text:
Olivia (Events): OK team — proposing webinar topic: 'Pragmatic Inference at Scale: cost, latency, and graceful fallbacks'. Want quick takes on speakers, a 1-2 line abstract, and who can run rehearsals (aiming for tech check Wed 11am PT, full run Thu 10am PT).

Maria (Marketing): love the angle. 'Pragmatic' sells to PMs/engineers. Need a CTA for benchmarks + template prompts.

Raj (Product Marketing): wording thought: do we prefer 'Inference' or 'Serving'? Small SEO win for 'Inference' I think. Also we should call out 'live demo' in the abstract.

Ben (Growth): +1 for a customer example. Benchmarks + a customer story = higher conversion. Can we get Acme or Nimbus on the panel? @Zoe (CS) any openings?

Zoe (Customer Success): We can ask Acme — they've been trialing Dedicated. I'll ping their AE and report back by EOD.

Olivia (Events): Draft abstract v1: 'Real-world tactics for cutting inference costs while preserving latency and reliability. Live demo of batching, KV caching, and rollout fallbacks; panel with customer lessons.' Thoughts?

Sam (Design): short and clear. Maybe trim to: 'Tactics to lower inference unit costs without sacrificing latency. Live demo + customer lessons.' Keep it punchy.

Danny (Eng): I can demo a mini pipeline showing batching + prefix caching. Plan to show before/after latency + token cost. Will need model variants pre-uploaded to the demo infra.

Olivia (Events): Nice. Speaker slate suggestion: Danny (technical demo), Raj (product/benchmarks narrative), Maria (marketing CTA & assets), Acme rep (customer story). Backup speaker: Ben or Sam.

Ben (Growth): I can be backup and own lead gen funnel + post-webinar drip. Also suggest a short pre-webinar survey in the registration flow to segment leads.

Raj (Product Marketing): For the 2-line speaker intro copy: 'Raj, Product Marketing at Redwood — runs inference benchmarks and model rollout playbooks.' Short and scannable.

Olivia (Events): Rehearsal plan draft — tech check (30m) Wed 11am PT: audio, demo infra, slides link; Full run (60m) Thu 10am PT: 10m intros, 25m demo, 15m panel, 10m Q&A. Running script below:

Olivia (Events): ```
10:00 - Host welcome (2m)
10:02 - Product context & benchmarks (8m)
10:10 - Live demo: batching + caching (25m)
10:35 - Customer panel: lessons learned (15m)
10:50 - Q&A (8m)
10:58 - CTA & close (2m)
```

Maria (Marketing): That run looks solid. Can we slim the demo to 20m if the customer wants more time? Flexibility is good.

Danny (Eng): I can fit demo into 20m if we drop some deep-dives. Will prepare a 'deep-dive' appendix slides for the blog follow-up.

Zoe (Customer Success): Acme says yes to a 10-12min panel slot if we share questions in advance. They'll confirm speaker name tomorrow.

Sam (Design): I'll prepare two slide templates: main deck + appendix. Also can make a 1-slide demo flow diagram for the host to cue.

Ben (Growth): I'll own registration copy and the pre-webinar survey (3 questions max). Will coordinate with Maria for CTAs and follow-ups.

Olivia (Events): Action items:
- Zoe: confirm Acme rep (EOD)
- Danny: demo infra + short checklist (Mon EOD)
- Sam: deck templates (Tue noon)
- Maria & Ben: registration copy + survey (Tue EOD)
- Raj: benchmark snippets for slides (Tue EOD)
- Olivia: create calendar invites + rehearsal slots (today)

Raj (Product Marketing): Also recommend we run a quick smoke benchmark on Redwood Dedicated vs hosted to show a cost/latency delta. I'll send a slide with numbers.

Olivia (Events): Can everyone make Thu 10am PT for the full run?

Maria (Marketing): yes

Ben (Growth): yes

Danny (Eng): yes, but if I'm blocked, Sam can cover the demo live with scripts.

Sam (Design): yes

Zoe (Customer Success): tentatively yes (waiting on Acme confirmation)

Olivia (Events): Great — I'll lock calendar and set rehearsal invites. If we need to swap timings, flag here. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Added full run invite Thu 10:00 PT for: Olivia (Events), Maria (Marketing), Raj (Product Marketing), Ben (Growth), Sam (Design), Danny (Eng) — meeting link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/meet/1825

Olivia (Events): Thanks — will follow up with docs and runbook in this thread once slides + demo checklist are in.

Maria (Marketing): Quick note on promotion: let's target dev community channels + LinkedIn. Will draft 2 variations of LinkedIn copy and run A/B on the hero line.

Ben (Growth): For lead routing, I'll set up segmentation: trial users -> sales SDR; non-trial -> marketing nurture. We'll map in the survey.

Zoe (Customer Success): Acme confirmed speaker: Maya Lopez, Senior ML Eng. She can present a short config + outcome.

Olivia (Events): Excellent — Maya onboarded. Closing loop: rehearsal Wed 11am PT tech check, full run Thu 10am PT. Everyone add slides to the shared drive by Tue EOD. Thanks!
